answers.explanation: CannotPullContainerError in private subnets is usually missing NAT/endpoints path to ECR, not inbound SG rules. Night 9 Q6 / night-10-lab troubleshooting step 1.
Execution role pulls images and writes logs before the app starts; task role is for application runtime (S3). Week 1 Night 6 Q4 / Night 5 execution vs task role.
S3 writes use task role credentials. Execution role is for ECS infrastructure (pull/logs), not app data plane.
awslogs needs HTTPS egress to CloudWatch Logs — same NAT/endpoints path as ECR. Policy on execution role is not enough without network reachability.
Without an S3 gateway endpoint, S3 API calls from private subnets use NAT to reach the public S3 endpoint (charges apply). Night 8 Q6 / week2-vpc-plan.md.
ECR pulls need ecr.api + ecr.dkr interface endpoints; layers live in S3 so add S3 gateway endpoint. Night 8 Q2 flashcard #5.
Security groups are stateful — outbound 443 to ECR allows return traffic without explicit inbound rules. Night 8 Q3 / Night 9 Fargate SG design.
NAT is outbound-only from private subnets; no inbound initiation from the internet. Night 8 Q5.
RunTask caller must iam:PassRole so ECS can assume execution and task roles. Exam: PassRole for ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com.
End-to-end validation: task wrote CloudWatch logs and produced S3 output — confirms pipeline ran in private networking.
